title: Neutron stars can cool by emitting neutrinos from their interior.
narration: Deep inside a neutron star, extreme heat generates neutrinos that escape, carrying away energy and cooling the star over time.
ssml: <speak>Deep inside a neutron star, extreme heat generates neutrinos that escape, carrying away energy and cooling the star over time.</speak>
